experimental_method: Flow calorimetry (Picker-type, Spectroflow pumps) giving the specific heat capacity of Na2SO4(aq) relative to pure water at 200 bar from 413 to 573 K; apparent molar heat capacities calculated with a heat-loss correction factor f.
uncertainties_stated: Column Unc: per-value uncertainty of phi_Cp from +-0.00015 in P_s/P_w and +-1% in (P_s-P_w)/P_w and in f.
quality_remarks: Densities of the solutions (25 C, 200 bar) were taken from literature (Chen et al. 1977 below 0.33 m; estimated from Gibson 1934 compressibilities above), so rho_s is not a measurement of this paper. Molality column has no unit printed. Replicates at identical molality kept. Temperature scale not stated.
